# PR #2149: Patch: undo and redo in the deck editor

Closes #2099

The deck open in `/decks` now has Undo and Redo, built exactly to the plan.

What changed:
- [history.ts](/home/agent-muse/actions-runner-fill/_work/_temp/work/item-2099/apps/web/src/game/deckbuilder/history.ts) (new): pure per-deck history — `recorded`, `sealed`, `undone`, `redone`, `historyKey`, `inTextField`. Each step is sent back through `store.updateDeck`, so undo/redo save and sync like any edit (R256). A rename's keystrokes fold into one step until the name field blurs.
- [DeckWorkshop.tsx](/home/agent-muse/actions-runner-fill/_work/_temp/work/item-2099/apps/web/src/game/deckbuilder/DeckWorkshop.tsx): history state that resets when the open deck changes, `editDeck`/`undo`/`redo`, Ctrl/Cmd+Z and Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+Z handling outside text fields, and Undo/Redo icon buttons in the top bar, each disabled with nothing to move. Closing the editor ends its history.
- [DeckEditor.tsx](/home/agent-muse/actions-runner-fill/_work/_temp/work/item-2099/apps/web/src/game/deckbuilder/DeckEditor.tsx): new `onRenameDone` prop, called on the name field's blur to seal a rename into one step.
- Supporting bits: `DECK_UNDO`/`DECK_REDO` testids, `.ws-history` styles, zh-CN "撤销"/"重做", and the `game/deckbuilder/` row in `apps/web/README.md`.

How I tested it (all commands run, all output seen):
- `vitest run src/game/deckbuilder/history.test.ts` — 7 passed.
- `vitest run src/game/deckbuilder/DeckWorkshop.test.tsx` — 52 passed, including the 6 new `issue #2099` tests.
- `vitest run src/game/deckbuilder src/emotes/PortraitPicker.test.tsx src/routes/decks.test.tsx src/i18n/i18n.test.ts src/wording.test.ts` — 439 passed across 16 files.
- `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck` — clean. `pnpm exec eslint apps/web e2e` — clean.
- `cargo jackioh spec check` — 1338 rulings, 3026 proofs, ok.

Decisions the issue did not settle: none beyond the plan — I followed its five pre-made choices (history in `DeckWorkshop`, "← All decks" clears it, icon buttons, shortcuts active on `<select>` focus, no step cap). One departure worth a look: my first draft of `history.ts` dropped `future: []` from `recorded`'s return, so a new edit after Undo kept Redo alive; the plan's own unit test caught it and the file now matches the plan verbatim.

### Adversarial review
